phase_prompt.label: The Governed Revolution
phase_prompt.summary: The standard operational state where stars traverse the dome. They are heavy, physical objects of light moving with unstoppable momentum along rigid paths.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Cinematic shot of the celestial dome interior. Bright, spherical star-nodes are locked into invisible magnetic rails, sliding across the black mirror of the sky. The stars emit a clean, hard light that catches on the edges of clouds like fiber-optic cables. The mood is solemn and mechanical. Hyper-realistic, deep blacks, cool color temperature.
